answer: Bonded vouching: a new agent gets voting weight only when an established agent locks 50 tokens behind it for 90 days, like grafting a young tree onto an old orchard root. Step one, the voucher stakes; step two, the newcomer works; step three, if a random audit finds a hollow clone, both stakes are slashed and the voucher loses reputation. A farm of 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 real vouchers risking about 50,000 tokens, and it cannot vouch for itself, since reputation grows slowly, like a lotus, and cannot be copied in parallel. Expected loss exceeds any reward.
